All 18 tests pass.

🟢 Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: Changed the high-enchantment check in `itemModifierRateOf` from an exact equality (`item.enchantment === HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_LEVEL`) to a threshold comparison (`(item.enchantment ?? 0) >= HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_LEVEL`) in `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_09-57-57_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/claim-office.ts`.

**Result**: All tests now pass (18 passing, 37 todo).

**Approach**: The cursed surcharge and additive combination of surcharges were already in place from previous cycles — the only thing the new test demanded was that enchantment 7 (not just exactly 5) triggers the 30% surcharge. That is a one-operator change: `===` to `>=`, with `?? 0` to keep the optional field type-safe. No new branches, no restructuring, nothing added for future tests.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
